title: Shops III: Zoologist (bestiary-gated) and Golfer (working golf); Leather Whip becomes obtainable
player_outcome: The Zoologist's stock grows as you fill the bestiary: Leather Whip, Fairy Glowsticks and critter-themed items, plus the pet licenses (P5-20). The Golfer sells clubs that knock bouncing golf balls into enemies and golf cups and tees to place.
design: Zoologist entries gated with {type:'bestiary', min:N} at Terraria thresholds (verify on the wiki): leather_whip, fairy_glowstick (new: a thrown light that sticks), critter_shampoo (new dye), license_cat/dog/bunny (items defined in P5-20).

Golfer: golf_club_iron/driver/wedge/putter (new: melee swing plus a shootProjectile 'golf_ball_shot' using ammo class 'golf_ball', each club with different speed/arc), golf_ball (ammo), golf_cup and golf_tee (tile objects), golf visor/shirt/pants (vanity). Projectile golf_ball_shot: friendly, gravity, bounces 6, low damage.

No new Core code; this uses shootProjectile and ammo classes. If a club needs both melee and shooting, depend on the items phase's fix for sword+projectile (audit F); otherwise make the clubs pure shooters.
files_add: data/items/town_shop_golf.json — golf and zoologist items + golf_ball_shot projectile
data_changes: about 12 new items/objects; bestiary thresholds on shop entries
tests: ShopDataTests.ZoologistGatedByBestiary: with a fake IPlayerRecords at 9% the leather_whip is not in Stock; at 10% it is
